Representation is separate from fuel quality, prices and community ratings.
A free account may request scoped representation. Independent review checks the signature and corporate authority. Sending a document grants no access.
Never send private keys, passwords, PFX or P12 files. Signed PDF only, up to 5 MiB. Files with scans use the 24-hour retention cap.
Requested scope: business information and official replies. No authority over community prices or ratings.
